title: Work schedules
subtitle: Set who works each Saturday (and holidays if needed). Swaps are just moving people between Working ↔ Off.
noHolidays: No holidays in this month. Add holidays under Organization or use Saturdays only.
unpublished: Schedule not published yet — timesheet uses the normal shift.
savedWithTimesheet: Schedule saved and timesheet updated (Saturday load).
clearConfirm: Remove this day’s schedule? Timesheet will fall back to the shift only.
copyPrevHint: Copies who worked / was off on the previous Saturday.
noPrev: No previous Saturday with a schedule in this month.
swapHint: Click two people (one working, one off) to swap them.
forbidden: Only admins, HR and managers can build schedules.
hintHoliday: People marked Working on a holiday are expected on the timesheet; others stay holiday.
hintSaturday: Only people marked Working are expected this Saturday; Off does not count as absence.
editingThisDay: You are editing this day’s schedule
chipPastTitle: Past Saturday — view only (Admin/HR can correct)
pastBanner: Past day — informational for the timesheet. Managers view only; Admin/HR can correct.
pastReadOnlyManager: Past Saturday: view only. Ask Admin/HR if a correction is needed.
loadFromShiftHint: Load comes from the profile shift (or store default), including Saturday hours if set on the shift.
publishDesc: Send the {{month}} schedule to each employee on selected channels.
publishPdfHint: Each employee receives an individual PDF with the month calendar (shift + Saturdays/holidays).
publishNeedChannel: Select at least Email or WhatsApp.
publishNoRecipients: No eligible employees (check WhatsApp opt-in and email).
publishNoRecipientsSelected: Select at least one employee to send to.
